CONTENT
COMMENTS
BEST
MINE
NOTES
Read a description of a situation. Then write an e-mail about the situation. You will have 9 minutes. You should aim to write at 50-120 words. Write using complete sentences.
ITEM TEXT
You
are
going
to
your
friend
Jim's
company
to
give
a
public
presentation
,
but
you
have
never
been
to
their
office
before
.
Because
you
are
unfamiliar
with
the
venue
,
you
decide
to
email
Jim
to
inquire
about
relevant
information
:
1
.
Ask
Jim
if
the
meeting
room
at
his
company
is
equipped
with
various
presentation
equipment
such
as
a
computer
,
projector
,
etc
.
2
.
Inquire
whether
any
additional
materials
are
needed
for
meetings
at
Jim's
company
.
3
.
Ask
Jim
how
many
people
at
his
company
are
currently
interested

and
